_doc: Lens profiles for capture devices. focal_px = (long side / 2) / tan(horizontal FOV of the long side / 2) x video_crop. Field of view from the spec (diagonal, 4:3 still) or the 35 mm equivalent; video_crop = narrower video field (stabilisation / 16:9 crop). Values marked 'estimate' are to be checked against calibrated captures. Galaxy rows other than S24 (2026-10-27): 35 mm equivalent or spec FOV from BE research + the S24 video_crop; match = model code without the region letter (S20 FE left out on purpose -> lens search). iPhone rows (2026-10-27): Apple publishes no front focal length, so the 35 mm equivalent comes from real video records of the generation (12: 25, 14 Plus / 16 Pro: 24, 17 Pro: 20) and the Apple specs (MP, aperture, autofocus) group the models; match = model name as the video records it, the longest match wins (iPhone 17e over iPhone 17).

galaxy-s24-front.label: Galaxy S24 셀프(전면) 카메라
galaxy-s24-front.source: spec 80 deg FoV (f/2.2, 1/3.94in); video_crop: eun01 2026-10-15 (f=1560 px at 1080x1920 put the jaw / profile outline on the photos; auto lens search picked 897 = 6 % wider face)

galaxy-a-26mm-front.label: Galaxy A14·A15·A16·A34·A52·A52s·A53·A54·A55·A72·A73 셀프(전면) 카메라
galaxy-a-26mm-front.source: S15P31B204-468 research 2026-10-30: Samsung publishes no front FOV for the A series. GSMArena 26 mm: A14 (https://www.gsmarena.com/samsung_galaxy_a14-12151.php), A14 5G (-12004), A15 (-12637), A34 (-12074), A52 (-10641), A52 5G (-10631), A52s (-11039), A53 (-11268), A54 (-12070), A55 (-12824), A72 (-10469), A73 (-11257). A15 5G / A16 / A16 5G have no figure: same 13MP f/2.0 front as the A15 (Wikipedia 27 mm / 78.1 deg, uncited). Wikipedia lists 25 mm for A34 / A52 / A53 / A54 (about 4 % apart). Production 10-29: an A52s ran the full lens search and picked 943 px (the search also picked 897 px for the S24 where 1560 px fits, so it is not a measurement). video_crop 1.09 borrowed from galaxy-s24-front (eun01 measured): 35 mm / FOV figures are for the 4:3 still, video is narrower

A23 / A25 / A33 / A35: GSMArena has no figure, Wikipedia 25 mm (uncited). video_crop 1.09 borrowed from galaxy-s24-front (eun01 measured): 35 mm / FOV figures are for the 4:3 still, video is narrower

Inner camera (phone open); folded, the rear cameras film. video_crop 1.09 borrowed from galaxy-s24-front (eun01 measured): 35 mm / FOV figures are for the 4:3 still, video is narrower

A Z Flip7 original video records 22 / 23 in udta/smta/lens (S15P31B204-467). Inner camera (phone open). video_crop 1.09 borrowed from galaxy-s24-front (eun01 measured): 35 mm / FOV figures are for the 4:3 still, video is narrower

galaxy-zfold4-6-cover-front.label: Galaxy Z Fold4 / Fold5 / Fold6 커버 화면 셀프(전면) 카메라
galaxy-zfold4-6-cover-front.source: Samsung newsroom spec cover camera 10MP F2.2, FOV 85 deg (Fold4 https://news.samsung.com/global/introducing-samsung-galaxy-z-flip4-and-galaxy-z-fold4-the-most-versatile-devices-changing-the-way-we-interact-with-smartphones; Fold5 https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-galaxy-z-flip5-and-galaxy-z-fold5-delivering-flexibility-and-versatility-without-compromise; Fold6 https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-galaxy-z-fold-6-and-z-flip-6-elevate-galaxy-ai-to-new-heights); GSMArena 24 mm. The video does not say which camera filmed: the cover camera is taken (the phone used folded, like a bar phone). The inner under-display camera is 4MP, FOV 80 deg (Fold6 newsroom: 85) / 26 mm - a video from it has a narrower field and its fixed trial may fail, then the lens search runs (S15P31B204-467). video_crop 1.09 borrowed from galaxy-s24-front (eun01 measured): 35 mm / FOV figures are for the 4:3 still, video is narrower

Before: 23 mm + video_crop 1.12 assumed (1429 px, 12 % too long)
